method.method_draft: First describe the visible structure: each lower row is two squares longer than the row above, forming row lengths 1, 3, 5, and 7, and each row alternates colors starting and ending with white. Read from the problem that all rows begin and end with white. Generalize the row length: row n has 2n - 1 total squares. In an alternating row that starts and ends white with an odd number of squares, the white squares occupy the odd positions and the black squares occupy the even positions. Therefore the number of black squares is half of the remaining positions: (2n - 2)/2 = n - 1. For n = 37, this gives 36.
